users.title: Users
users.intro: Create accounts, change their settings and decide what each person can see. Every change is checked again by the server and written to the audit log.
users.signedOutSelf: This change ended your own session. Please sign in again.

list.title: Accounts
list.caption: Accounts on this server
list.includeDeletedHint: Deleted accounts can be restored from their detail page.
list.emptyHint: Create the first account with the form below.

status.title: Account status
status.isDisabled: This account is disabled and cannot sign in.
status.disableImpact: Disabling signs this account out on every device and blocks new sign-ins until it is enabled again. Its data, grants and rules are kept.
status.enableImpact: Enabling lets this account sign in again. Sessions ended by disabling stay ended.
status.disabledDone: {name} was disabled and signed out everywhere.

native.title: Native app login
native.isAllowed: This account may sign in from native apps.
native.isDenied: This account may not sign in from native apps.
native.allowImpact: Allowing lets native apps on this person's devices sign in with this account; the web interface is not affected.
native.revokeImpact: Withdrawing revokes every active native app session of this account at once and blocks new native sign-ins. Web sessions are not affected.
native.revokedDone: Native login withdrawn; native sessions were revoked.

form.name: Sign-in name
form.nameHint: Used to sign in; at most 128 bytes.
form.adminHint: Administrators manage the server and see every library.
form.hiddenHint: Not listed on sign-in screens that show accounts; the person signs in by typing the name.

create.title: Create an account
create.passwordHint: {min}–{max} bytes, used exactly as typed (no trimming).
create.nameTaken: This sign-in name is already in use.
create.invalid: The server did not accept these values. Check the name and password.

detail.title: Account
detail.selfNotice: This is your own account. Changing your role, disabling or deleting it, or revoking all sessions signs you out.
detail.deletedNotice: This account is deleted. Restore it to change its settings.

settings.title: Settings
settings.impact: Changes apply at once and are written to the audit log.
settings.roleImpact: Changing the role signs this account out on every device.

limits.title: Delivery limits
limits.impact: Leave a field empty to follow the server setting; enter 0 for no limit. New values apply to viewing started after saving; viewing in progress is not interrupted.
limits.serverSwitch: Each limit takes effect only while the matching limit is switched on in the server settings.
limits.bandwidthHint: Shared by all of the account's viewing; whole number from 0 to {max}.
limits.invalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to {max}, or leave empty.

libraries.title: Library access
libraries.impact: Library grants are the outer boundary: content rules below can only narrow them, never widen them. Changes apply to the account's next request.
libraries.emptyMeans: With nothing checked, a non-administrator sees no library at all.
libraries.adminNote: This account is an administrator: administrators always see every library, so these grants only matter if the role is removed.
libraries.noneSelected: No library selected: this account will see nothing.
libraries.noLibraries: No libraries on this server yet

content.title: Content restrictions
content.impact: Restrictions hide items within the granted libraries. Changes apply to the account's next request and are written to the audit log.
content.noPreview: There is no preview of how many items a change hides; check with this account after saving.
content.ceilingImpact: Hides items whose rating is above the ceiling, together with their seasons and episodes. A series rated higher hides all of its episodes.
content.unratedImpact: Decides whether items with no recognized rating are shown under a ceiling.
content.unratedInactive: Without a ceiling, the setting for unrated items has no effect.
content.tagsImpact: Hides any item whose own or parent tags or genres match (case-insensitive). At most {max}.
content.tagDuplicate: This tag is already in the list.
content.tagLimit: At most {max} tags can be blocked.
content.saveNote: Rating ceiling, unrated handling and tags are saved together; item rules below are saved one by one.

rules.title: Item rules
rules.impact: A rule applies to the item and everything under it (seasons, episodes). Rules apply at once and are written to the audit log.
rules.hideImpact: Hide: hides the item and its descendants.
rules.allowImpact: Allow: shows the item despite blocked tags and the rating ceiling, but never outside the granted libraries.
rules.nearestWins: The nearest rule wins: a rule on an episode overrides one on its season or series.
rules.caption: Item rules of this account
rules.removePrompt: Delete the rule on {title}? The item follows the remaining restrictions again at once.
rules.searchHint: Searches the items you can see; up to 10 results.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.caption: Active sessions of this account
sessions.revokeAllImpact: Revokes every session of this account, web and native, at once. The person can sign in again unless the account is disabled.

lifecycle.title: Sign-in lock and deletion
lifecycle.unlockImpact: Resets failed sign-in attempts and lifts a temporary lock. Harmless if the account is not locked.
lifecycle.unlocked: {name} can try to sign in again.
lifecycle.deleteImpact: Deleting signs the account out everywhere and permanently removes its watch history and personal data. The account itself can be restored later, but that data does not come back.
lifecycle.deletePrompt: Delete {name}? Watch history and personal data are removed for good.
lifecycle.restoreImpact: Restoring lets the account sign in again with its old password. Sessions revoked by the deletion stay revoked, and deleted watch history does not come back.
